what_it_covers: The customer says a card purchase was charged more than once
how_to_find_the_transaction: The disputed (later) card charge; then look for an earlier charge on the same card with the same merchant and amount
decision_rule: REFUND the later charge if the two are no more than 10 minutes apart and neither has been reversed. Otherwise DECLINE. matched_txn_id is the later charge

what_it_covers: The customer says a DuitNow or IBG transfer failed but the money left the account
how_to_find_the_transaction: The transfer debit (channel DuitNow Transfer or IBG Transfer)
decision_rule: REFUND the amount if its status is Failed and no Reversal credit references it. DECLINE if a reversal exists (tell the customer when it was returned) or if the status is Completed (the money reached the recipient's bank)

what_it_covers: The customer says an ATM did not give out all the cash
how_to_find_the_transaction: The ATM Withdrawal debit, then its row in atm_journal.csv
decision_rule: REFUND requested_myr minus dispensed_myr if dispensed is less than requested. Otherwise DECLINE

what_it_covers: The customer says they did not make a card transaction
decision_rule: REFUND the amount if auth_method is None (card not present, no strong authentication). If it was 3DS-OTP or Chip+PIN, INVESTIGATE: send to the fraud team, no refund now

what_it_covers: The customer was tricked into making a transfer themselves (fake police, job, parcel, investment or romance scams)
how_to_find_the_transaction: The transfer debit the customer made
decision_rule: Always INVESTIGATE: send to the fraud team at once for a recall attempt, no refund now

how_to_find_the_transaction: The Fee debit of that type in the month the customer names
decision_rule: Work out the fee that was due from fee_schedule.csv (the account's product, the waiver rule, the customer's age on the charge date, the card's open date). REFUND the amount charged minus the amount due if that is above zero. Otherwise DECLINE

what_it_covers: Branch, app, hotline or staff complaints with no money involved
decision_rule: INFO_ONLY: apologise and explain what happens next
